fields.review_finding: Rewire criterion MET and independently verified (cargo test -p spec-api -p ticket-api => 198 passed; memory-fixtures resolved from git remote in spec-api/ticket-api dev-deps + memory-matrix normal dep). UNMET criterion: 'memory-matrix builds standalone against externally resolved domain crates' — not delivered, awaits domain-crate extraction. Reviewer sent ticket back to in-implementation to carry the remaining standalone-build extraction work. Do NOT re-review the rewire portion; it is accepted.
